description: Show the account's storage, database and files apart: database bytes per app as last measured (null with a note until first measured, a few minutes after the first write) and file bytes per app, each total vs the plan's limit, plan, whether writes are blocked for being over the database storage limit (file storage full only stops new uploads), snapshot usage, and the database server's state (running/stopped: it sleeps when idle and wakes on the next request).
name: usage
